Title: The Secret World of Arrietty
Writer: Mary Norton, Hayao Miyazaki, Keiko Niwa
Actors: Mirai Shida, Ryûnosuke Kamiki, Tatsuya Fujiwara
Plot: The Clock family consists of three four-inch-tall people who live incognito among humans, borrowing only what they need to survive. Their quiet life changes when their teenage daughter, Arrietty, is discovered.
